targets.rawSql: SELECT COUNT(id) AS 'Total Open PRs' FROM pull_requests WHERE status = 'OPEN' AND merged_date IS NULL AND closed_date IS NULL AND (base_repo_id IN ($repo_id) OR '$repo_id' = 'All');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS 'Awaiting First Review' FROM pull_requests pr LEFT JOIN pull_request_comments prc ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id AND prc.account_id != pr.author_id AND prc.type IN ('DIFF', 'REVIEW') WHERE pr.status = 'OPEN' AND pr.merged_date IS NULL AND pr.closed_date IS NULL AND prc.id IS NULL AND (pr.base_repo_id IN ($repo_id) OR '$repo_id' = 'All');

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT pr.id) AS 'Overdue (>24 Calendar Hours)' FROM pull_requests pr LEFT JOIN pull_request_comments prc ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id AND prc.account_id != pr.author_id AND prc.type IN ('DIFF', 'REVIEW') WHERE pr.status = 'OPEN' AND pr.merged_date IS NULL AND pr.closed_date IS NULL AND prc.id IS NULL AND TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, pr.created_date, NOW()) > 24 AND (pr.base_repo_id IN ($repo_id) OR '$repo_id' = 'All');

SELECT COALESCE(AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, pr.created_date, NOW())), 0) AS 'Avg Waiting Time (h)' FROM pull_requests pr LEFT JOIN pull_request_comments prc ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id AND prc.account_id != pr.author_id AND prc.type IN ('DIFF', 'REVIEW') WHERE pr.status = 'OPEN' AND pr.merged_date IS NULL AND pr.closed_date IS NULL AND prc.id IS NULL AND (pr.base_repo_id IN ($repo_id) OR '$repo_id' = 'All');

SELECT pr.id AS 'PR ID', pr.base_repo_id AS 'Repo', pr.title AS 'Title', pr.author_name AS 'Author', pr.created_date AS 'Created At', TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, pr.created_date, NOW()) AS 'Wall-Clock Hours Waiting', pr.additions AS 'Additions', pr.deletions AS 'Deletions' FROM pull_requests pr LEFT JOIN pull_request_comments prc ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id AND prc.account_id != pr.author_id AND prc.type IN ('DIFF', 'REVIEW') WHERE pr.status = 'OPEN' AND pr.merged_date IS NULL AND pr.closed_date IS NULL AND prc.id IS NULL AND (pr.base_repo_id IN ($repo_id) OR '$repo_id' = 'All') ORDER BY pr.created_date ASC LIMIT 50;

panels.title: Oldest Open PRs Awaiting First Review

targets.rawSql: SELECT r.name AS 'Repository', COUNT(pr.id) AS 'Open Awaiting Review' FROM pull_requests pr JOIN repos r ON pr.base_repo_id = r.id LEFT JOIN pull_request_comments prc ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id AND prc.account_id != pr.author_id AND prc.type IN ('DIFF', 'REVIEW') WHERE pr.status = 'OPEN' AND pr.merged_date IS NULL AND pr.closed_date IS NULL AND prc.id IS NULL GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY 2 DESC;

SELECT r.name AS 'Repository', AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, pr.created_date, NOW())) AS 'Avg Wall-Clock Wait (h)' FROM pull_requests pr JOIN repos r ON pr.base_repo_id = r.id LEFT JOIN pull_request_comments prc ON pr.id = prc.pull_request_id AND prc.account_id != pr.author_id AND prc.type IN ('DIFF', 'REVIEW') WHERE pr.status = 'OPEN' AND pr.merged_date IS NULL AND pr.closed_date IS NULL AND prc.id IS NULL GROUP BY r.name ORDER BY 2 DESC;
